notes.title: Fixing UI, dynamite and rope
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Addressed scaling issues with UI
[*] Fixed "Collect dynamite" not showing after dynamite is ignited
[*] Fixed "Collect dynamite" for unlit dynamite not working vertically
[*] Reworked button combos for grabbing and pulling rope to be more consistent
[*] Redesigned rope puzzle
[*] Enabled detonator (experimental)
[/olist]

notes.title: Improved controller support
notes.content: Patched UI and settings menu to work better with controllers

notes.title: Patch Feb 20
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Revamped hub area, including info for puzzle portals
[*] Redesigned the first puzzle to reduce chance of softlock
[*] Added two failsafe-mechanics to reduce chance of softlocking at drill construction
[*] Buffed minecart: Can now collect gold while inside it
[*] Sand.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dying in the hub sending you to the shadow realm
[*] Double-cracked ice becoming indestructible when rotating
[*] Main menu navigation missing on controller
[/list]

notes.title: Added settings menu
notes.content: Settings menu added: Window mode, music and SFX volume, action hints
